name: gladys-bsblan
description: Gladys Assistant external integration for boilers and heat pumps with a Siemens controller (ELCO, Brötje, Baxi, MHG...) through the BSB-LAN adapter, over the local network: temperatures, comfort setpoint, heating mode, hot water, optional commands with a capped hot water setpoint. Unofficial, not affiliated with the BSB-LAN project nor the manufacturers.
